viewDefinition:
CREATE VIEW [STAR].[FACT_Order Details] AS
SELECT
	T1.[FK_Order Details],
	T1.[FK_Orders],
	T1.[FK_Customers],
	T1.[FK_Employees],
	T1.[FK_ReportsTo],
	T1.[FK_Shippers],
	T1.[FK_Products],
	T1.[FK_Categories],
	T1.[FK_Suppliers],
	T1.[FK_OrderDate],
	T1.[FK_RequiredDate],
	T1.[FK_ShippedDate],
	T1.[UnitPrice],
	T1.[Quantity],
	T1.[Discount],
	T1.[Total],
	T1.[FK_SNAPSHOT]
FROM
	[DWH].[FACT_Order Details_T] T1
